title: Investigate a conversation and its cost

blocks.content: Agent Observability captures every generation your agent's SDK records and groups them into conversations. A conversation holds each generation's input and output, the context the agent had when it answered, the dependencies between generations when your code declares them, and an estimate of what each call cost. This path reads that record for the sample conversations the one-click demo seeds, so you can investigate without an agent of your own.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll have:

- Found the one demo conversation whose status is errored and jumped to its first errored generation
- Read that generation's input, output, tool call, and the agent context captured for it, and asked it a question about its step
- Opened a generation's trace in Tempo and come back to the conversation
- Opened one agent in **Agents** and read its versions, the prompt and tools each version used, and its quality scores by version
- Read a conversation's dependency graph in **Dependencies** and its step timing in **Workflow**
- Broken the estimated cost chart in **Analytics** down by **Agent** and **Model**, and read where a cost figure's price comes from

## Before you begin

- A Grafana Cloud stack with Agent Observability enabled. If you have not enabled it, complete the [Connect an agent to Agent Observability](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/connect-agent-to-agent-observability/) path first.
- The Agent Observability Reader role on that stack, which reads conversations, analytics, traces, and agents. Grafana Admins have the Agent Observability Admin role by default, which covers it.
- The one-click demo data seeded on that stack. The Seed the demo data guide does this in one click. Items the demo created carry a **Demo** badge.
- Milestones 3 and 6 go further on a stack that also receives data from an agent of your own, such as the one you connected in that first path. Each of those milestones tells you what the demo data covers and what needs your own agent.

For the reference on what you will read, refer to [Conversations](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/agent-observability/observe-and-troubleshoot/conversations/) and [Dashboards and analytics](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/agent-observability/observe-and-troubleshoot/dashboards/).

## How this path fits the journey

This path is the hands-on part of the [Investigate agents and costs](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/investigate-agents-and-costs/) journey. The journey explains each view before you open it and picks the path up again between milestones, so keep the journey open in another tab.

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

We understand you might want to explore other capabilities not strictly on this path. We'll provide you opportunities where it makes sense.
